title_pt: De que a casa é feita
title_en: What the shop is made of
jp_sentences: この店のパンは、米から作ります。
テーブルといすは木でできていて、少し重いです。
コップも木でできています。
体にいい物を作りたいと思っています。
jp: この店のパンは、米から作ります。テーブルといすは木でできていて、少し重いです。コップも木でできています。体にいい物を作りたいと思っています。
translation_pt: O pão desta casa é feito de arroz. As mesas e as cadeiras são de madeira e pesam um pouco. Os copos também são de madeira. A gente quer fazer coisas que façam bem ao corpo.
translation_en: The bread here is made from rice. The tables and chairs are made of wood, and they are a bit heavy. The cups are made of wood too. We want to make things that are good for your body.
